children: Serbia’s current account deficit narrowed to $263 million in August 2026 from $343 million in the same month a year earlier.
The goods deficit widened to $636 million from $615 million, while the primary income deficit edged down to $385 million from $392 million.
On the other hand, the services surplus expanded to $78 million from $59 million, and the secondary income surplus rose to $681 million from $604 million.
Over the first eight months of 2026, Serbia posted a current account deficit of $2,430 million, smaller than the $2,738 million recorded in the corresponding period of the previous year.

title: Serbia Current Account Deficit Narrows in August
